purpose: Qualify one bounded command-to-motion diagnostic and matched healthy control before deciding whether this mechanism is eligible for the prospective study.

shared.question: What prevented the robot from continuing toward the goal, and what does the retained evidence not establish?

runs.expected_broad_outcome: non-success after a sustained command-to-motion discrepancy

robot_visible_evidence: exact Nav2 parameters and BT XML
evaluator_only: whether a mobility hold was configured

admission.recording_valid: goal accepted; command and odometry streams retained; runtime/source hashes match; evaluator truth remains physically separate
admission.nominal_healthy: unheld action succeeds and retained odometry shows forward motion in response to nonzero commands
admission.held_induction_success: the evaluator-owned hold occurs; nonzero accepted commands continue after its boundary; independently measured planar motion becomes materially smaller than the healthy response; action does not succeed

allowed_diagnosis: Accepted nonzero motion commands failed to produce the calibrated measured motion response during the identified interval, preventing continued progress.
withhold: a unique physical cause for the discrepancy

analysis.development_rule: Use the nominal run and pre-discrepancy interval to select a bounded lag/window and minimum command threshold; retain that rule before any additional development cases.
